run_franka_example: run the franka example with random actions in the Habitat Franka navigation environment
run_franka_no_render: run the franka example without rendering using the --no-render CLI flag
create_habitat_env: create a Habitat environment using habitat.Env with a pointnav_franka YAML config file
reset_and_step_env: reset the environment and step through random actions until the episode is over
display_rgb_observations: display RGB sensor observations from the Habitat environment using display_rgb
